units.source_text: 境遇变更，不知结果如何，心中不安。

en.t: With her circumstances changed, she did not know how things would turn out, and her heart was uneasy.

units.source_text: 回思过去多年之间，其实何必忧愁苦闷呢？

en.t: Looking back over all those past years, what need had there really been for sorrow and anguish?

units.source_text: 她恨不得年光倒流、回复昔日才好。

en.t: She wished that time could flow backward and restore the days of the past.
